title: Defend: outbuf is deferred-allocated, not pre-allocated at open()
description: crypto2dev_fd.c — outbuf starts NULL; allocation happens in outbuf_grow() only when update() or finalize() actually produces output. A reviewer might suggest pre-allocating CRYPTO2DEV_OUTBUF_INIT=4096 bytes at open() to 'simplify' the NULL checks. This would be wrong: KEY fds, DO_SIGN, DO_VERIFY, DO_AGREE, and STATUS calls never produce output — pre-allocation would waste heap on every fd open. The deferred model also allows hash/HMAC sessions (which produce only 32-64 bytes) to never allocate more than they need. The NULL checks in read() and outbuf_grow() are the correct, minimal-allocation design.
